name: Sari Pacific Jakarta, Autograph Collection
short_description: Iconic Jakarta landmark on Jl. M.H. Thamrin, open since 1976 (originally the world's first Pan Pacific), now an Autograph Collection hotel with 400+ rooms, strong service, a good breakfast and a central location.
ai_summary: Sari Pacific Jakarta, Autograph Collection is a heritage landmark on Jl. M.H. Thamrin in Central Jakarta, operating since 1976 as the world's first Pan Pacific and rebranded into Marriott's Autograph Collection in 2022 (Jakarta's first Autograph property). Its calling card is location: guests walk to Sarinah, Grand Indonesia and Plaza Indonesia, with Monas and Bundaran HI minutes away. Across independent blogs and TripAdvisor (roughly 4.0/5 from about 1,170 reviews; ranked in the top third of Jakarta hotels), the consistent praise is for warm, attentive service and a generous breakfast spread, where the bakso and Indonesian stations are repeatedly singled out. The property leans into a classic, nostalgic feel rather than a hyper-modern one; some renovated rooms feel fresh and spacious, while other areas and bathrooms read as dated. Elite recognition and club-lounge value are frequently called the best in town for the price. Recurring negatives are the aging hard product, occasional road/motorcycle noise, and phased renovations affecting facilities such as the gym. Overall it suits travelers who want a central, characterful base with strong hospitality over cutting-edge design.

faqs.question: Where is Sari Pacific Jakarta located and how far is the airport?
faqs.answer: It sits on Jl. M.H. Thamrin No. 6 in Central Jakarta, within walking distance of Sarinah, Grand Indonesia, Plaza Indonesia, Bundaran HI and the National Monument (Monas). Soekarno-Hatta International Airport (CGK) is roughly 28 km away, about 45-75 minutes by car depending on traffic.

faqs.question: Is Sari Pacific Jakarta a historic hotel?
faqs.answer: Yes. It opened in 1976 as the world's first Pan Pacific hotel and later operated as Sari Pan Pacific. In 2022 it joined Marriott's Autograph Collection, becoming Jakarta's first Autograph property, and retains a heritage, nostalgic character.

faqs.question: What do guests say about the rooms and breakfast?
faqs.answer: Breakfast is a highlight, with reviewers praising the spread and the bakso in particular. Rooms draw mixed feedback: renovated categories feel spacious and fresh, while some older rooms and bathrooms are described as dated. Service is consistently well reviewed.

reviews.title: [HOTEL REVIEW] : Staycation at Sari Pacific Jakarta
reviews.author: Aline
reviews.summary: Staycation in a 60 sqm Pacific Room with separate living area, kitchenette and two TVs. Praises the Fiesta breakfast buffet with standout pastries, Japanese weekend brunch, Pacific Lounge cocktails and the central location.

reviews.title: Pengalaman Menginap di Hotel Bintang 5: Sari Pacific Jakarta
reviews.author: Vera Situmorang
reviews.summary: Family staycation near Thamrin. Highlights classy service from front office to room service, clean and fragrant rooms, and a generous, high-quality breakfast. Convenient location near shopping; guest says she would happily return.

reviews.title: Pengalaman Menginap di Hotel Sari Pacific Jakarta
reviews.summary: Trip report from a spacious, vintage-style room. Appreciates the retro design, central Thamrin location and strong AC, but notes dated bathroom fixtures and slow, inattentive breakfast/restaurant service with limited variety.
